_about: Example file for the wizard's Import-from-file feature.
This is the 'json-schema' shape — a thin {tables: [...]} description
that data catalogs (dbt, Atlan, OpenMetadata) and OpenAPI tools
typically produce. The importer auto-detects the shape from the
top-level `tables` key and turns each table into a wizard entity
(or event by name heuristic), each column into a property, each
declared FK into a relationship.
Drop this file on the wizard's Step 1 'Import from file' card.
The review modal will show a curated mix of issues to demonstrate
the validation tiers:
Errors:      0
Warnings:    MISSING_BASE_IRI · NO_CQS
Suggestions: SUGGEST_PROPERTY_SENSITIVITY × 3
(customer.email + customer.ssn → Confidential,
customer.password → Restricted)
SUGGEST_DESCRIPTION × 1
(column with no description gets a heuristic wording)
The transaction_log table is auto-routed to events at parse time
because of the `_log` suffix — no SUGGEST_EVENT row appears.
(Soft-FK suggestions only fire on the SQL import path; for JSON
schemas, FKs must be declared explicitly.)
Try Accept-all-pending in the Suggestions tab to apply every
auto-fix at once, then check the Preview tab to see the resulting
session JSON before clicking 'Accept & replace session'.
